title: Release-Verifier vollständig ressourcengebunden abschließen
goal: Schließe die Ressourcenhärtung des RepoGround-Release-Verifiers auf Basis des gemergten PR #1113 ab. Bewahre die inzwischen gemergten Grenzen für Manifest, SHA256SUMS, Symlinks, Archive und Git-Blob-Gesamtgröße, halte weiterhin höchstens einen Blob gleichzeitig im Speicher und verwende beim source-bound Vergleich genau einen geöffneten Leser für den bereits materialisierten Tar-Inhalt, ohne fremde schmutzige Checkouts zu verändern.

approval.note: The user request in the active ChatGPT conversation authorized exactly this isolated RepoGround T019 implementation. The implementation was claim-bound, reviewed, tested and merged before this verified transition.

acceptance.assertion: Implementation starts from RepoGround merge commit 37a83704695532f8c8d17a532709e3de92cafb38 or a proven descendant and preserves the archive, member, decompressed-stream, compression-ratio and member-count limits delivered by PR #1113.

The release manifest and SHA256SUMS have explicit byte ceilings, are required to be regular non-symlink files, and are rejected before full parsing or line processing when those contracts are violated.
Source-bound verification rejects the aggregate size of all immutable Git blobs before starting the content batch when it exceeds the explicit repository-content ceiling.
The persistent git cat-file content batch holds, verifies and discards at most one bounded blob at a time and does not accumulate the full repository content in memory.

The source-bound repository comparison opens the already materialized Tar content exactly once, reuses validated TarInfo.offset_data positions for all regular entries and preserves all existing size, type, mode, symlink and content checks.

Regression tests cover oversized and symlinked manifest input, oversized SHA256SUMS, aggregate repository-blob overflow before content reads, one-at-a-time blob handling, one Tar reader for source-bound comparison and the existing archive/PAX/GNU resource-limit cases.

Targeted release tests, repository hygiene, Ruff, maintainability ratchets, full pytest, CodeQL and post-merge CI are green on the final reviewed head; the proof distinguishes PR #1113 baseline evidence from the closeout patch.

historical_remaining_findings: candidate manifest and SHA256SUMS are read without explicit pre-read byte ceilings
source-bound Git blob sizes are individually bounded but not aggregate-bounded before content streaming

resolved_findings: candidate manifest and SHA256SUMS have pre-read byte ceilings and regular non-symlink file checks
source-bound Git blob sizes have an aggregate ceiling before content streaming
the source-bound repository comparison opens and reuses one materialized Tar reader

reviewed_plan.basis: PR #1113 and merge commit 37a83704695532f8c8d17a532709e3de92cafb38 were read back with green post-merge CI. The two historically remaining security findings were resolved on RepoGround commit 5318daaad4eceed60cd752eacd057ec74bbd9e49. The remaining repeated Tar-open finding was then implemented and verified through RepoGround PR #1117.

activation.basis: User requested autonomous selection and implementation of one RepoGround task through Grabowski.

verified_acceptance.merged-baseline-bound: PR #1117 starts from RepoGround main 5318daaad4eceed60cd752eacd057ec74bbd9e49, a proven descendant of PR #1113 merge 37a83704695532f8c8d17a532709e3de92cafb38; all existing release-resource regressions remained green.
verified_acceptance.bounded-candidate-metadata: The existing manifest and SHA256SUMS ceiling and regular-file tests passed in the 54-test release-packaging suite and in GitHub pytest-full.
verified_acceptance.bounded-repository-total: The aggregate immutable Git-blob ceiling remained unchanged and its pre-content-batch regression passed.
verified_acceptance.single-blob-memory: The persistent git cat-file batch still reads, validates and discards one bounded blob at a time; the existing one-at-a-time tests passed.
verified_acceptance.single-tar-reader: Head 555ba94de69aec5a9af332b9402357dd0a7e90b5 opens the materialized Tar once, reuses validated TarInfo.offset_data positions, rejects short reads and closes the handle after the comparison; the new regression passed.
verified_acceptance.adversarial-regressions: All 54 release-packaging tests passed locally and the full GitHub pytest suite passed on the exact reviewed head, including archive, PAX/GNU, size, symlink and sandbox cases.
verified_acceptance.final-ci-and-proof: All RepoGround PR workflows were green on head 555ba94de69aec5a9af332b9402357dd0a7e90b5 and all eight push workflows were green on merge commit c0bd029f0be3f370cf946fb311380ea3ea9df4ea; the proof was updated in the merged PR.

validation: Local Ruff, graph-maintainability, module-reachability, no-test-stubs and git diff --check succeeded.
Two independent release builds were byte-identical and both source-bound verifications succeeded.
RepoGround PR #1117 CI succeeded on reviewed head 555ba94de69aec5a9af332b9402357dd0a7e90b5, including pytest-full and CodeQL.
RepoGround post-merge CI succeeded in all eight push workflows on c0bd029f0be3f370cf946fb311380ea3ea9df4ea.
The loaded-host RLIMIT_NPROC coupling observed during local full pytest was not reproduced on the fresh GitHub runner and is registered separately as REPOGROUND-LEGACY-RECONCILIATION-V1-T020.
